answer: In a market for falcon sightings and plume forecasts carried by a zephyr, voting weight flows from audited seed members through capacity-limited trust edges. Compute one global flow: aliases and cycles behind the same edges share capacity instead of minting new weight. A farm needs additional endorsements from independent seed-connected members, whose finite budgets cannot be reused. Buying those scarce links raises its cost; compromised seeds and colluding sponsors remain weaknesses.
